cold_email.subject: Interest in Educator (permanent) Aventura Mall — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear lululemon Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Educator (permanent) Aventura Mall opportunity with lululemon at lululemon.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Flight Analysis Engineer I/II — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Rocket Lab Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Flight Analysis Engineer I/II opportunity with Rocket Lab at Rocket Lab.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Communications Specialist CS9605 — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Oklahoma State University Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Communications Specialist CS9605 opportunity with Oklahoma State University at Oklahoma State University.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Unit Secretary - Plastic and Limb Salvage Unit — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear MedStar Georgetown University Hospital Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Unit Secretary - Plastic and Limb Salvage Unit opportunity with MedStar Georgetown University Hospital at MedStar Georgetown University Hospital.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Research Associate - Computer Science — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Institute for Defense Analyses Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Research Associate - Computer Science opportunity with Institute for Defense Analyses at Institute for Defense Analyses.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Analyst, Strategic Relationship Management - Deloitte University - Westlake — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Deloitte Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Analyst, Strategic Relationship Management - Deloitte University - Westlake opportunity with Deloitte at Deloitte.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Unit Secretary - Per Diem Nights — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Baylor Scott & White Institute for Rehabilitation Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Unit Secretary - Per Diem Nights opportunity with Baylor Scott & White Institute for Rehabilitation at Baylor Scott & White Institute for Rehabilitation.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Full Time Contract Educator / Legacy place — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear lululemon Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Full Time Contract Educator / Legacy place opportunity with lululemon at lululemon.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

Dear Seattle Clinical Research Center Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Clinical Research Coordinator opportunity with Seattle Clinical Research Center at Seattle Clinical Research Center.

More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

Best,
Celina Lin

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Pet Trainer opportunity with PetSmart at PetSmart.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Unit Secretary - Full-Time — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Baylor Scott & White Institute for Rehabilitation Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Unit Secretary - Full-Time opportunity with Baylor Scott & White Institute for Rehabilitation at Baylor Scott & White Institute for Rehabilitation.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Administrative Assistant- Same Day Surgery & OR — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Pullman Regional Hospital Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Administrative Assistant- Same Day Surgery & OR opportunity with Pullman Regional Hospital at Pullman Regional Hospital.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Lab Tech 1 Allegheny County 15205 (M-F 7:30am-4:30pm or 8:00am-5pm) — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear ABB OPTICAL GROUP Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Lab Tech 1 Allegheny County 15205 (M-F 7:30am-4:30pm or 8:00am-5pm) opportunity with ABB OPTICAL GROUP at ABB OPTICAL GROUP.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Admissions Counselor: Enrollment Management — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Temple University Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Admissions Counselor: Enrollment Management opportunity with Temple University at Temple University.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Biomedical Writer — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Cadent, powered by Syneos Health Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Biomedical Writer opportunity with Cadent, powered by Syneos Health at Cadent, powered by Syneos Health.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Pet Trainer — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear PetSmart Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Pet Trainer opportunity with PetSmart at PetSmart.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

jobs.title: Automation Engineering Team Lead
jobs.location: United States - North Carolina - Rocky Mount
jobs.description: USE YOUR POWER FOR PURPOSE The Automation Engineering Team Lead is a key member of the Site Digital and Automation Leadership Team, responsible for leading the Operations Services function. Reporting to the Site Digital and Automation Lead, this role works in close partnership with them to deliver and continuously enhance operational support while providing leadership oversight across all digital and automation activities at the site. The role is accountable for managing 24/7 plant operations support, including oversight of automation system performance, project execution, and support of new product introductions. It ensures strong collaboration between site operational teams, core Digital & Automation teams, and above-site partners to enable efficient and aligned delivery. A primary responsibility of this position is to ensure the safe, compliant, and reliable operation of all automation systems, fully aligned with GMP, data integrity, and cybersecurity requirements. The incumbent drives stakeholder engagement and cross-functional alignment across site and PNA network. WHAT YOU WILL ACHIEVE Automation Operations & Production Continuity Manage the Operations Services team and coordinate work plans. Ensure the provision of technical expertise in automation control system design and lifecycle management. Drive continuous improvement projects, assist other teams, and ensure uptime, compliance, and data integrity. Act as the primary operational point of contact for Engineering, Manufacturing, and Operations partners for all run-state digital and automation systems. Ensure appropriate on-call / out-of-hours support model is in place to sustain 24/7 operations. Support NPI projects and new equipment introduction. Ensure effective Automation Engineering operational support, including ownership of control systems, hardware, instrumentation, and PLC environments. Automation Maintenance & Lifecycle Support Ensure proactive maintenance strategies, plans and execution. Ensure that statutory and regulatory compliance requirements are satisfied and support audit/ inspection readiness. Ensure lifecycle planning for obsolescence management, patching, and system upgrades. Incident, Crisis & Business Continuity Response Manage incident response for automation and digital systems within agreed SLAs, overseeing triage, escalation, coordination, and communication with site stakeholders. Collaborate with network support teams and Site Digital and Automation lead to assisting in crisis response, recovery and business continuity undefined. Control Systems & Automation Infrastructure Management Drive key control systems strategies focusing on process optimization, system integration areas and modernisation. Oversee technical support contracts for automated systems. Ensure alignment with site and above-site architecture standards, cybersecurity policies, and network segmentation requirements. Own site automation roadmap and capital planning.Contributor to global automation topics and provide strategic direction within SME forums. Deliver Automation Systems continuous improvement initiatives using Six Sigma methodologies. Drive standardization and replication of best practices across site and network. Automation Engineering / Equipment level Coding Ensures new equipment and upgrades are ready for operations as projects transition to BAU support. Oversee lifecycle documentation, oversees project specs, contracts, purchases, and installations within budget. Manage changes and adhere to Automation Standards for software and hardware design. Coach and mentor technical teams and provide support for training undefined. Leadership and People Management Lead, coach, and develop site‑based colleagues and contract resources supporting digital and automation activities. Set clear expectations for behaviours, standards, and ways of working, including responsiveness, documentation quality, and delivery of core responsibilities. Conduct performance reviews to ensure career growth, and capability development across technical, operational, compliance, and problem‑solving areas to enable a future ready team. Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement across the team. Serve as a key member of the site Digital & Automation leadership community, partnering closely with peer leads across workstreams and with network partners. Ensure appropriate resourcing, succession planning, and capability building aligned to future digital and automation needs undefined. Key Attributes, Skills & Competencies Maintains expert knowledge of relevant automation systems, e.g. DeltaV DCS, PLCs, and PC-based platforms Strong understanding of GMP, regulatory expectations, and data integrity principles within pharmaceutical manufacturing. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess impact, troubleshoot effectively, and escalate appropriately. Proven ability to follow formal change control and documentation practices in regulated and validated environments. Demonstrated professionalism, continuous improvement, and personal development through day-to-day behaviors. Demonstrated stakeholder management and influencing skills across cross-functional teams. Experienced in leading technical automation programs and complex initiatives. HERE IS WHAT YOU NEED (Minimum Requirements) Applicant must have a bachelor's degree with at least 6 years of experience; OR a master's degree with at least 5 years of experience; OR a PhD with 1+ years of experience. Degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related technical field (or equivalent experience). Experience in Digital, Automation, IT systems, or related technical environments, with experience in a regulated manufacturing environment. Experience leading and developing technical teams, including people management within a matrix team structure. Experience managing technical projects, or programs within operational environments. Experience with delivery frameworks (e.g., Agile, SDLC, Project/Program Management). Knowledge of regulated environments and compliance requirements (e.g., GMP, change management, lifecycle governance). Demonstrated ability to make decisions, work independently, and collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams. Relevant certifications (e.g., Lean/Six Sigma, ITIL, Agile, or technical certifications) beneficial. Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact. OTHER JOB DETAILS Work Location Assignment: On Premise Last Date to Apply for Job: October 21, 2026 The annual base salary for this position ranges from $139,100.00 to $231,900.00. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 17.5% of the base salary and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. Learn more at Pfizer Candidate Site – U.S. Benefits | (uscandidates.mypfizerbenefits.com). Pfizer compensation structures and benefit packages are aligned based on the location of hire. The United States salary range provided does not apply to Tampa, FL or any location outside of the United States. Relocation assistance may be available based on business needs and/or eligibility. Candidates must be authorized to be employed in the U.S. by any employer. U.S. work visa sponsorship (such as TN, O-1, H-1B, etc.) is not available for this role now or in the future. cold_email.subject: Interest in Automation Engineering Team Lead — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Pfizer Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Automation Engineering Team Lead opportunity with Pfizer at Pfizer.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

jobs.title: Cyber, Infrastructure, Data, Integration, & Systems Team Lead
jobs.location: United States - North Carolina - Rocky Mount
jobs.description: USE YOUR POWER FOR PURPOSE The Cyber, Infrastructure, Data, Integration & Systems Team Lead is a key member of the Site Digital and Automation Leadership Team, responsible for leading this function. Reporting to the Site Digital and Automation Lead, this role works in close partnership with them to oversee the secure, stable, and compliant operation of Digital and Automation infrastructure within the manufacturing environment. The role works in close partnership with the Shop Floor Insights Lead to ensure the reliable, compliant, and efficient use of data across site Digital and Automation environments. The role establishes trusted, “AI-ready” data foundations to enable the delivery of innovative AI and analytics solutions for the site. The role oversees cybersecurity, network, and infrastructure lifecycle and support activities to ensure Digital and Automation systems remain resilient, secure, and inspection‑ready, protecting critical digital assets and supporting reliable plant operations. The role also leads execution of site-level data strategy, data standards, and system integrations in alignment with network and global standards. They ensure manufacturing data is accurately captured, contextualized against the enterprise data model, governed to GxP standards, and made available for site and enterprise use. This role leads day-to-day execution, lifecycle, and project activities related to data systems, historians, core system integrations, and local applications. The role owns the site data enablement roadmap and is accountable for advancing site data maturity. This role enables consistent data flows across core platforms while maintaining compliance, validation, and inspection readiness. The role works closely with the Cyber Security & Network Group, the Global Cyber Security team, and cross-functional partners to support secure infrastructure operations, incident response, and continuous improvement at site level. The incumbent drives stakeholder engagement and cross-functional alignment across site and PNA network. WHAT YOU WILL ACHIEVE Governance, Regulations & Standards Oversee all work in alignment with applicable quality, cybersecurity, and regulatory requirements, following established SOPs and governance processes; and mitigate and escalate deviations or risks as required. Collaborate on the Digital and Automation response for inspections, audits, and assessments by providing accurate documentation, data, and technical input when requested. Accountable for identification, documentation, and escalation of cybersecurity and infrastructure risks, including management of exceptions and residual risks. Architecture, Controls & Cybersecurity Delivery Accountable for site-level cybersecurity and network activities in accordance with established Digital and Automation architecture, cybersecurity, and network standards. Ensure implementation and execution of approved control strategies and tools to maintain secure and compliant Digital and Automation environments. Oversee vulnerability remediation activities, ensuring execution of defined controls and risk mitigation actions. Guide cybersecurity planning activities by providing technical input, execution feedback, and documentation in line with approved strategies and standards. Coordinate local or global cybersecurity, infrastructure, and Digital & Automation related projects. Operations, Monitoring & Lifecycle Manage day-to-day Digital and Automation infrastructure operations, including proactive monitoring, incident handling, and issue resolution for assigned systems and network components. Ensure accurate asset and configuration inventory records for assigned Digital and Automation systems and network components; ensure updates are performed in a timely manner to support lifecycle, cybersecurity, and inspection readiness. Oversee and align change management activities for infrastructure and cybersecurity changes, including impact assessments, documentation updates, and coordination with relevant stakeholders. Direct software and hardware lifecycle management activities (e.g. patching, upgrades, and end-of-life tasks) following approved plans and change management processes. Drive EOSL asset evaluation and prioritization using defined decision frameworks (e.g. EOSL Decision Priority Matrix) to support risk-based lifecycle decisions. Ensure alignment of lifecycle activities with annual budget planning and long-term capital planning processes in collaboration with site Digital and Automation financial planning owners. Identify and escalate unfunded EOSL risks, ensuring appropriate remediation or mitigation strategies are defined. Support development of site-level infrastructure investment plans by contributing to Site Master Plans and capital planning processes for long-term remediation of EOSL and infrastructure risks in collaboration with site Digital and Automation financial planning owners. Monitor site performance against cybersecurity, vulnerability remediation, and EOSL targets using defined dashboards and reporting tools; drive timely remediation actions and escalate gaps as required. Ensure all Digital and Automation assets have clearly defined ownership and are accurately maintained in relevant systems (e.g. CMDB) to support governance, reporting, and audit readiness. Incident, Crisis & Business Continuity Lead incident, deviation, recovery activities and escalations to enable secure and timely return-to-service while maintaining data integrity and validated state control. Ensure business continuity readiness by managing recovery procedures/playbooks for assigned services and infrastructure and participating in recovery/failover testing or continuity drills as required. PANS Support Supervise PANS-related activities, ensuring configuration baselines are maintained, plant network stability is monitored, and deviations or risks are identified for escalation. Data Strategy, Standards & Governance Lead the development, documentation, and execution of the site end-to-end data strategy in alignment with network direction. Drive and reinforce data standards to ensure consistency, integrity, and compliance in how data is structured, stored, and used. Ensure data-related work is executed in line with applicable quality, validation, cybersecurity, and regulatory requirements, following established SOPs and governance processes. Represent site in cross-site standards harmonization reviews, bringing site operational knowledge to inform enterprise model evolution. System Integration & Data Flow Enablement Oversee and support core system integrations, ensuring seamless, secure, and compliant data flow, connectivity and design across system layers. Formulate and manage site data enablement roadmap. Develop and execute plans to advance site data maturity, including planning for funding, resources and above site support where required; and mapping to business value enabled for the site. Identify and pursue solutions to data connectivity, identifying integration issues, data quality gaps, or performance risks and escalating as required. Validate that asset hierarchy, equipment context, process parameters, and batch/lot identifiers are accurately represented in the contextualization layer. Lead implementation, configuration, and lifecycle management of site historians and data platforms to enable operational reporting, analytics, and continuous improvement. Drive local application development/ rationalization or configuration, including upgrades, enhancements, retirement and connectivity to data sources. Lead incident, deviation, and recovery activities to ensure timely restoration of services while maintaining data integrity and validated state control. Enable use of data for analytics, AI, and innovation initiatives by ensuring data availability, reliability, and alignment to defined standards. Lead development and deployment of AI tools and agents to support Digital & Automation priorities. Conduct performance reviews and support capability development across technical, operational, compliance, and problem‑solving areas. Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement across the team. Serve as a key member of the site Digital & Automation leadership community, partnering closely with peer leads across workstreams and with network partners. Ensure appropriate resourcing, succession planning, and capability building aligned to future digital and automation needs. cold_email.subject: Interest in Continuous Skills Development Trainer — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Walmart Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Continuous Skills Development Trainer opportunity with Walmart at Walmart.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Pet Trainer opportunity with PetSmart at PetSmart.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Pet Trainer — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear PetSmart Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Pet Trainer opportunity with PetSmart at PetSmart.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.body:
Dear PetSmart Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Pet Trainer opportunity with PetSmart at PetSmart.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. cold_email.body:
Dear PetSmart Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Pet Trainer opportunity with PetSmart at PetSmart.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. jobs.title: Automation Engineering Manager
jobs.location: United States - North Carolina - Rocky Mount
jobs.description: USE YOUR POWER FOR PURPOSE The Automation Engineering Manager is a member of the Site Digital & Automation Team and is accountable for leading automation operations, lifecycle management, and production continuity across site automation and digital systems supporting manufacturing operations. This role provides leadership, direction, and governance across automation engineering activities, ensuring reliable, compliant, and efficient operation of production-critical systems. The role works in close collaboration with Operations, Engineering, and Core Digital & Automation partners. WHAT YOU WILL ACHIEVE Automation Operations & Production Continuity Lead automation operations to ensure production continuity and system reliability across the site. Serve as escalation point for automation-related production issues and coordinate resolution across teams. Provide guidance to Operations and Engineering on automation system performance and risks. Ensure smooth transition of systems from project delivery into business-as-usual operations. Automation Maintenance, Lifecycle Support Own automation lifecycle management ensuring systems remain compliant, validated, and fit for purpose. Establish and enforce standards for lifecycle documentation, change management, and validation. Oversee regulatory compliance aligned with GMP, GAMP, and audit requirements. Drive periodic reviews, system upgrades, and proactive lifecycle planning. Incident, Crisis & Business Continuity Support Lead site-level response to major automation incidents and crises impacting production. Ensure effective Business Continuity Plan (BCP) readiness, testing, and execution. Coordinate cross-functional and vendor support during high-severity events. Ensure incident documentation, root cause analysis, and corrective actions are completed. Control Systems & Automation Infrastructure Management Manage control systems and automation infrastructure including DCS, PLC, SCADA, HMI, and related systems. Drive governance of system changes, upgrades, and infrastructure improvements. Oversee vendor engagement, system integration, and technology roadmap execution. Ensure alignment to site and network architecture standards. Process Automation & Continuous Improvement Lead continuous improvement initiatives to enhance automation and manufacturing systems performance and reliability. Drive standardization of automation practices and coding standards. Enable data-driven decision making and performance optimization. Leadership & Stakeholder Management Provide technical and operational guidance across automation activities. Drive stakeholder engagement across Operations, Engineering, and Digital teams. Ensure alignment with site priorities and network strategies. Key Attributes, Skills & Competencies Strong leadership capabilities. cold_email.body:
Dear Pfizer Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Automation Engineering Manager opportunity with Pfizer at Pfizer.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do. Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives. Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career. Engineer I What you will do Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will support manufacturing activities associated with cGMP equipment and facilities at Amgen Thousand Oaks (ATO). The engineer works in partnership with the automation, maintenance, project management, corporate engineering, and manufacturing to develop and lead all aspects of the operation and reliability of equipment while driving safety and quality compliance. The engineer will support the department and capital projects and provide data to support business cases and long term strategy. The Engineer role will provide direct engineering technical support as follows: Model leadership behaviors and positive values to create a positive working environment. Be individually accountable for consistent equipment performance and reliability Be accountable for assigned results on key capital projects Suggest design modifications to address risks and design in quality and safety. Provide oversight for verification work developed by outsourced/contract verification staff. Act as a liaison between Engineering, Automation, Maintenance, Instrumentation, and Quality Assurance during project planning, execution, and closeout Ensure that validation protocols are executed and documented in accordance with cGMP good documentation and safety practices. Ensure safety during commissioning, validation, maintenance, and manufacturing activities Initiate and drive continuous improvement activities and projects to completion. Participate or lead, when required, multidisciplinary site teams, e.g. Multi-functional Team, Root Cause Analysis lead. Support Lean Transformation and Excellence in Operations process improvement by leading, supporting, and documenting improvement opportunities to reduce cost, improve safety/quality, or improve speed. Provide ad hoc technical support and guidance for manufacturing and maintenance Mentor and guidance to project teams and engineers using risk-based approaches Defend the equipment-specific calibration, maintenance, & validation as required during regulatory inspections Participate in internal audits and assess in conjunction with quality assurance Assist in developing and maintaining business metric performance What we expect of you We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is a leader with these qualifications. Basic Qualifications: Master’s degree OR Bachelor’s degree and 2 years of engineering and/or manufacturing experience OR Associate’s degree and 6 years of engineering and/or manufacturing experience OR High school diploma / GED and 8 years of engineering and/or manufacturing experience Preferred Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in engineering or another science-related field 7+ years of relevant work experience with 5+ years’ experience in operations/manufacturing environment Direct experience with regulated environments (FDA, OSHA, EPA, etc.) Knowledge and experience with cGMP procedures and engineering practices on pharmaceutical/biotech production processes, clean utilities, facilities, instruments, and equipment Experience implementing risk-based verification on major GMP process equipment / automation projects, including validation protocol development and execution Experience with combination product / medical device quality systems verification Process equipment knowledge – basic principles of cell culture, fermentation, purification, filling Process automation knowledge – fundamental understanding of automation infrastructure Knowledge of Delta V, Rockwell, and Plant Information Systems is a plus Strong communication and technical writing skills Strengths in facilitation and collaboration / networking Experience in developing SOPs and delivering training Individual must be a standout colleague prepared to work in and embrace a team-based environment that relies on collaboration for effective decision-making Basic understanding of process improvement methodologies to mature and improve business performance (examples: PDCA, LEAN, Six Sigma, etc.) What you can expect of us As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information. Sponsorship Sponsorship for this role is not guaranteed. As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease. jobs.title: Staff Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity? At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients. Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible. We are a leader in the development of innovative DNA sequencing instruments that transform the landscape of genomics. Our flagship products, such as the NovaSeq X and 6K series, drive scientific discoveries across healthcare and biotechnology. Join us and bring your expertise to products that make a difference globally. As a Staff Electrical Engineer in our Lifecycle Management team, you will be a technical leader responsible for overseeing the entire electrical-system lifecycle of our high-performance sequencing products — from New Product Introduction (NPI) through sustaining phases until end-of-life. You will lead and manage technical LCM projects end-to-end, guiding a sub-team of engineers while personally driving the most complex technical investigations. This role demands a dynamic, fast-learning, and highly flexible engineer who can manage component End-of-Life (EOL), drive supplier and design changes, and lead product improvements — all while adhering to our Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Instructions (WIs), and software/PLM platforms. Critically, you must be comfortable owning the High-Performance Compute (HPC) / Compute Engine (CE) server domain, which increasingly defines instrument performance and cost on top of generic CPU/FPGA based electronics. You will have the opportunity to lead, mentor, and grow the team, and to progress toward broader electrical-systems engineering leadership. Key Responsibilities: LCM Operation — Technical Project Management Lead and own LCM technical projects end-to-end — scoping, planning, execution, risk management, and release — across component EOL/shortage response, redesign, qualification, and documentation. Familiar with instrument PDP and LCM (Life Cycle Management) process. Oversee the electrical-system (PCA, cables, sub-systems, modules) lifecycle of flagship sequencers (NovaSeq X, 6K series) from initial development through product end-of-life. Proactively address electrical component EOL and supply-shortage issues, manage supplier changes, and execute design modifications to ensure product longevity and continuity of supply. Support and provide technical guidance on NC/RMA processing HPC / Compute Engine (Server) Domain Serve as a technical owner for the HPC / Compute Engine server sub-system — leading qualification, validation, DVT setup, peer design review, and release of CE hardware and cost-reduction initiatives. Troubleshoot server-class hardware issues (POST/boot behavior, PCIe enumeration, memory training/DIMM & SSD compatibility, BIOS/firmware interactions) and translate findings into sustainable design and sourcing actions. Partner with software/firmware, product development, and strategic sourcing to balance sequencing performance against CE cost and supply risk. Compliance, Quality & Test Ensure all engineering activities comply with internal SOPs, WIs, and company software/PLM platforms and infrastructure. Champion testing as a quality-control measure; contribute to the design and implementation of test fixtures and related engineering tools. Maintain product compliance (EMI/EMC and safety standards) through change events and support certification documentation. Leadership & Mentorship Act as a technical leader and mentor, guiding senior and junior engineers, and lead a sub-team as the organization grows. Provide technical direction during investigations, set clear ownership/SME roles, and support the EE team’s leadership-succession plan. Maintain strong cross-functional relationships (NPI, Manufacturing, Field Service, Quality, Sourcing), driving product improvements and lifecycle decisions aligned with company goals. cold_email.subject: Interest in Staff Electrical Engineer — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Illumina Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Staff Electrical Engineer opportunity with Illumina at Illumina.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

jobs.title: Engineer II
jobs.description: Career Category Engineering Job Description Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do. Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives. Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career. Engineer II Duties: Support the Corporate Environmental Sustainability program by developing, tracking, and reporting energy, carbon, water, and waste reduction metrics across global sites, with primary focus on refrigeration and cold room systems; Provide sustainability and environmental performance support for refrigeration and cold room projects, including CO (R744), ammonia, and other low-GWP systems within GMP-regulated environments; Assist with technical reviews of refrigeration and cold room project documentation including specifications, load calculations, controls, and performance data to support energy efficiency and sustainability goals, under the guidance of senior engineers or subject matter expert; Support refrigerant transition and decarbonization efforts by collecting asset inventories, operational data, and emissions inputs for existing refrigeration systems, and documenting findings for evaluation by senior engineering staff; Support analysis of refrigeration system–specific energy and operational data using established methodologies to assist senior staff in evaluating potential energy-efficiency and emissions reduction opportunities; 6. Support alignment of refrigeration and cold room projects with environmental regulations, refrigerant standards including Environmental Protection Agency, American Society of Heating, Refrigerating and Air-Conditioning Engineers, and International Organization for Standardization, and corporate sustainability frameworks, ensuring technical compliance across global sites; Collaborate with engineering, facilities, quality, and sustainability teams to coordinate data, documentation, and sustainability deliverables associated with refrigeration projects; Maintain technical awareness of emerging refrigeration sustainability standards, regulatory changes, and industry best practices, including natural refrigerants and advancements in energy-efficient cold chain technologies; Assist in preparing sustainability documentation, analyses, reports, and preliminary assessments, including energy, emissions, cost-impact, water, and waste reduction opportunities using established templates; Support measurement and verification activities and benchmarking in accordance with established M&V protocols; Support coordination and participation in external sustainability initiatives, including the MIT CEP Energy Prize sponsorship and the BioPhorum Sustainability Water Workstream, by assisting with documentation, communications, and material preparation in alignment with corporate sustainability objectives; Assist with data compilation, documentation, and coordination activities related to ENERGY STAR award submissions and other sustainability recognition programs, including support for third-party audit processes; and Support development and implementation of electric vehicle (EV) infrastructure initiatives at existing sites by assisting with data analysis, documentation, and coordination activities. May telecommute. Requirements: Master’s degree (or foreign equivalent) in Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering or related field & 1 year of experience in the job offered or in an engineering-related occupation. Position requires 1 year of experience in the following: Supporting sustainability, energy efficiency, or environmental engineering projects within GMP-regulated biotech manufacturing environments; Applying measurement & verification principles to collect, calculate, and report energy performance data and support savings verification activities; Supporting conservation-focused or sustainability improvement projects under the direction of senior staff; Supporting water reduction initiatives by applying quantitative water balance analyses to calculate and document estimated water savings and water efficiency improvement opportunities for industrial or GMP-regulated manufacturing systems, including Purified Water (PW) and Water for Injection (WFI); Working on industrial refrigeration systems, including industrial-scale CO (R744) and other low-GWP refrigerants; Supporting sustainability reporting activities and environmental performance metrics calculations, including data preparation for Environmental, Social, and Governance and Carbon Disclosure Project reporting, using defined tools and templates; Supporting calculation of scope 1 and scope 2 emissions estimates for refrigeration systems; \Supporting third-party energy performance validation programs or audits, including data collection and documentation for recognition programs such as ENERGY STAR; Supporting financial justification analyses including: Net Present Value, Rate of Return, and Simple Payback for sustainability initiatives; Enterprise ChatGPT modelling for business and engineering analysis; and PI Enterprise to extract and analyze energy, water, and operational data to support sustainability and performance assessments. Measurement & Verification Professional (CMVP-IT or CMVP) certification required. Contact: Interested candidates please apply via https://careers.amgen.com/en/search-jobs and search for job # R-255472. Job type: Full-Time position. The annual salary range for this position in the U.S. is $97,109.00 - $131,383.00 per year. Also, this position offers stock, retirement, medical, life and disability insurance and eligibility for an annual bonus or for sales roles, other incentive compensation. For more details visit https://careers.amgen.com/life-at-amgen/benefits/ What you can expect of us As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way. The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is posted. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications. In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include: A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan Stock-based long-term incentives Award-winning time-off plans Flexible work models, including remote and hybrid work arrangements, where possible Apply now and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team. careers.amgen.com In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information. Amgen does not have an application deadline for this position; we will continue accepting applications until we receive a sufficient number or select a candidate for the position. As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease. Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by applicable law. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. .
